decision: Cancellation timing and additional penalties before physical pickup

options.A: Allow cancellation before physical pickup, no additional monetary penalty, proportionate response to repeated abuse
options.B: Require a cutoff or seller approval for late cancellation
options.C: Add a monetary penalty for late cancellation or no-show
